title: Grenlandiya akulasi taxminan 400 yil yashashi mumkin

scenes.text: Olimlar hisobicha, Grenlandiya akulasi taxminan 400 yil yashashi mumkin.
scenes.keywords: greenland shark swimming dark cold water

scenes.text: Uning yoshini tishi yoki suyagidan emas, ko'zidan bilishgan.
Olimlar ko'z gavharini radiouglerod usulida tekshirib, yoshini baholashgan.
Demak, ba'zi akulalar bir necha asr oldin tug'ilgan bo'lishi mumkin.

description: Grenlandiya akulasi shimoliy sovuq suvlarda yashaydi va juda sekin o'sadi. 2016 yilgi tadqiqotda olimlar 28 ta akulaning ko'z gavharini radiouglerod usulida tekshirib, ular kamida 272 yil yashashini aniqlashgan. Eng yirik akulaning yoshi taxminan 392 yil (xatosi taxminan 120 yil) deb baholangan. U ma'lum umurtqali hayvonlar orasida eng uzoq yashaydigani hisoblanadi.
source: https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aaf1703 (Nielsen et al. 2016, Science 353:702-704: eye lens radiocarbon, at least 272 years, largest shark 502 cm about 392 +/- 120 years, longest-lived vertebrate known); https://sciencedaily.com/releases/2016/08/160812103711.htm; https://ora.ox.ac.uk/objects/pubs:633506; https://www.sci.news/biology/greenland-sharks-longest-lived-vertebrates-04099.html
